cat > /tmp/pp_test.py <<'EOF'
import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.nn.functional as F
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/obench-cell-onxjlil3/bench_opencode_torch-pipeline-parallelism_c8onj2bn")
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
dist.init_process_group("gloo")
r, ws = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
torch.manual_seed(0)
cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=100, hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64, num_hidden_layers=5, num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
model = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg).float()
ref = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg).float(); ref.load_state_dict(model.state_dict())
inp = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]; tgt = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]
loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, inp, tgt, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
tot = 0
for x,y in zip(inp,tgt):
    l = F.cross_entropy(ref(x).logits.reshape(-1,100), y.reshape(-1))/3; l.backward(); tot += l.item()
md = 0
for (n,p),(_,q) in zip(model.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
    if p.grad is not None: md = max(md, (p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
print(r, "loss", loss, tot, "max grad diff", md, "params w/ grad", sum(p.grad is not None for p in model.parameters()))
dist.destroy_process_group()
EOF
for n in 1 2; do torchrun --nproc_per_node=$n /tmp/pp_test.py 2>&1 | grep -v Warn | tail -3; done
